reading.zh: 本层阅读顺序：投稿管理 → 数据分析与粉丝画像 → 弹幕评论管理 → 活动任务与推广 → 激励收益与提现。箭头语义：call 同步调用、event 异步事件、dataflow 数据/投影流、reference 契约引用。
reading.en: Read in order: Work Management → Analytics and Audience → Interaction Moderation → Campaigns and Promotion → Revenue and Withdrawal. Arrow kinds: call, event, dataflow, reference.
